summary: The page is well-composed overall but suffers from a layout defect where the data table pagination overlays and obscures the bottom row of data.

issues.title: Pagination overlaps table data
issues.description: Floating pagination control overlaps the final row content instead of rendering in a separate container below the table.
issues.evidence: The floating pill displaying 'Showing 10 of 12 | < 1/2 >' is positioned directly on top of the tenth row, obscuring text in the Merchant and Date columns.
issues.suggestion: Position pagination in a dedicated footer area below the data rows with sufficient vertical spacing.
